name: Push banner
author: Brett
description: A banner listing every branch that isn't on main yet in AmberX-AXF and axHub (commits ahead/behind, age, last commit, its open PR and that PR's CI), with Open PR and Merge: every change reaches main only through its PR (one is opened for every branch), brought up to date with main and re-tested before it merges (not behind, CI passed on the pinned head; re-checked on the server). Auto-merge takes ready PRs oldest first, one merge per round, and sets branch protection on main where the token may. Auto-land (land/land.mjs, plain scripts on the VPS, no model calls) lands every finished build: worktree cleaned, main merged in with the builds files newer-wins, PR opened, CI started, merged here in dependency order once green and not held by UI Review; blocked builds are pushed to Brett once, in plain words. The console server talks to GitHub with its own token, which never reaches the browser. Merge queue (0.7.0): GitHub's own merge queue needs an organisation-owned repo, so the queue is ours: ready PRs line up, each is tested once on top of main + every PR ahead of it (queue/pr-<n> branches), the green head merges with no retest, a red one is kicked out with the reason in plain words and the ones behind it are retested without it; CI runs only what a change touches, PRs run light checks while the queue is on. Merge queue view, banner chip, REST + MCP + CLI. 0.7.1 (Nov 4 2026, Brett: "Stop merging these things one at a time"): auto-land is off by default and only the merge queue merges AmberX-AXF; GitHub reads are cached with ETags (a 304 costs no API call) and held back when the shared limit runs low; the console redeploys once per stack. 0.8.0 (Nov 10 2026, Brett: "Everything needs to go into the merge queue so we can make one build out of it before we send it to CI"): batch mode by default: every finished build gets a PR and joins the queue, up to batchSize ready PRs are combined into one commit on queue/batch, CI runs once, and a green batch lands on main as that one commit (one redeploy); a red batch is split in half until the PR that broke it is kicked out. Merge on AmberX-AXF puts the PR in the queue. 0.9.0 (Nov 11 2026, Brett: "If something fails, re-pull in main and rebuild it"): the merge gate (land/merge-gate.mjs, after the queue every round, plain scripts): a finished build that can't merge (code conflict, red test gate, too far behind) is auto-fixed (main pulled in, a fix session filed with the orchestrator) or fully rebuilt as <name>-rN on fresh main, up to 3 attempts, then held for Brett with the why of each attempt and a merge.blocked push; never pushes to main. Banner groups (yellow auto-fixing, blue rebuild, green passed / merged, red failed) with Clear, and the Merge log page: a grid of every entry with expandable rows, links and row commands (REST + MCP + CLI + voice).

items.title: Auto-land: every finished build
items.description: Every finished build the pipeline lands, in landing order, with its PR, state and what it waits on.

items.title: Auto-land: blocked builds
items.description: Finished builds that are not landing, each with the reason in plain words (UI waiting, CI red, conflict, dependency).

items.title: Auto-land: land a build now
items.description: Land one finished build at the next round (within 3 minutes), ahead of the rest; a hold on it is released.

items.title: Auto-land: hold a build
items.description: Keep a finished build from landing until it is released.

items.title: Auto-land: release a held build
items.description: Let a held build land again.

items.title: Merge queue: the line
items.description: Every PR in the merge queue in order: title, agent, test state (waiting, testing, passed, kicked out and why), ETA in minutes; plus the open PRs not in it and why, the last merged and kicked-out ones. Each PR is tested once on top of main + the PRs ahead of it and merges with no retest.

items.title: Merge queue: add a PR
items.description: Put a PR (back) in the merge queue: undoes Remove from queue or a kick-out at the same head. It still has to be ready (PR checks green, not a draft, not held by UI Review). Takes effect at the next round (within 3 minutes).

items.title: Merge queue: remove a PR
items.description: Take a PR out of the merge queue until it gets a new commit or is added again; the PRs behind it are retested without it.

items.title: Merge queue: move a PR
items.description: Move a PR to a new place in the merge queue (index, 0 = front). Jump to front is Brett's own click in the console; a session or agent may move a PR anywhere else. The stack behind the new place is retested in the new order.

to.description: new index, 1 or more from a session (0 = front is Brett's click)

items.title: Merge queue: settings
items.description: Batch mode (one build of up to batchSize ready PRs, one CI run, lands as one commit; a red batch is split in half until the PR that broke it is kicked out) or the per-PR stack, the batch size, and the queue on. Switching it off is Brett's own click. Returns the queue.

on.description: queue on (off is Brett's click only)

items.title: Merge log: every build the gate fixed or rebuilt
items.description: Every merge gate entry, cleared or not: build, state (auto-fixing yellow, full rebuild blue, passed / merged green, failed 3 times red), attempts with the why of each (conflicting files, failing checks and error lines, what the fix or rebuild changed), branch, PR, timeline, superseded builds; the banner groups and the settings.

items.title: Merge log: one entry
items.description: One merge gate entry by build id or PR number, with every attempt, its why and its links.

items.title: Merge gate: retry now
items.description: Start the next attempt now (auto-fix or full rebuild by the rules); a red one gets one more attempt. Voice: "retry the failed merges".

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: auto-fix now
items.description: Pull main into the branch and file a fix session with the orchestrator for the conflicts / failing checks.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: full rebuild now
items.description: File a fresh <name>-rN build from main with the original brief and the failure list; the old build is superseded and its PR closed. Voice: "rebuild X".

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: merge
items.description: Put its PR (back) in the merge queue, the normal merge path.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: skip
items.description: No more attempts; it stays in the log.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: toggle auto-merge
items.description: Auto-merge for this build on or off: off, a passed attempt waits for Merge.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: clear from the banner
items.description: Take entries off the merge banner (ids, or group failed = Clear reds, merged = Clear merged). They stay in the merge log.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: restore to the banner
items.description: Put cleared or archived entries back on the banner.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: archive
items.description: Archive entries (off the banner and out of the grid unless Archived is shown); kept forever.

group.description: every entry of a banner group instead of ids (Clear reds = clear + failed)

items.title: Merge gate: settings
items.description: The gate on, the attempt cap (1-6, default 3) and how far behind main a branch may be before it goes straight to a full rebuild (default 150 commits). Switching it off is Brett's own click. Returns the merge log.

on.description: gate on (off is Brett's click only)

behind.description: commits behind main before a rebuild (default 150)
